question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in `HEARTBEAT.md`, fold this into a broader scheduled-work override contract, or keep heartbeat model routing per-run/plugin-owned?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public task syntax, provider/model precedence, and shared-session behavior; automation should not choose that product/API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design scheduled-work routing first
options.body: Use this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42631 to choose one model/provider precedence model before adding heartbeat-specific syntax.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT.md task hints
options.body: Implement `model`/provider task fields, split or group due tasks by effective model, and cover shared-session restoration plus task timestamp behavior.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat currently routes one turn at a time through `heartbeat.model` or `before_model_resolve`, and require a new issue only if a missing generic plugin seam is proven.

recommendation.title: Design scheduled-work routing first
recommendation.body: Use this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42631 to choose one model/provider precedence model before adding heartbeat-specific syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a core-versus-plugin and public-config product decision, and steipete is the strongest available routing candidate from recent source and related product-boundary history.
